headline: Steelers rule out WR Pittman Jr. vs. Patriots with foot injury
summary: The Steelers will be without another starter for their Week 2 game against the Patriots after downgrading wide receiver Michael Pittman Jr. to out with a foot injury.

headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers downgraded to out because of hamstring injury
summary: The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.

headline: Rams' Puka Nacua again misses practice, questionable for MNF
summary: Rams receiver Puka Nacua will not practice for the second day in a row and will be listed as questionable for Monday night's game against the Giants.

headline: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold Could Be Out Until October
summary: The Seahawks have been hesitant to provide a clear timeline for the return of quarterback Sam Darnold from the injury he suffered in Week 1. Initial concerns about Darnold’s hip were allayed by testing that indicated his glute was impacted instead. headline: Dolphins Place LB Ronnie Harrison On IR
summary: The Dolphins announced today that veteran linebacker Ronnie Harrison Jr. has been placed on injured reserve. To fill Harrison’s spot on the 53-man roster, Miami signed linebacker Liam Anderson from the practice squad. headline: Bengals elevate Josh Johnson to active roster with Joe Burrow questionable
summary: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow says he plans to play tomorrow against the Texans.
